display_long_description:
Drift V — VR drift racing built around real sideways control

Most racing games ask you to stay on the line. Drift V asks you to break it. Feel the weight shift, catch the slide with counter-steer, and hold it all the way through the corner.

12 DRIFT TRACKS
Neon city streets, tight mountain hairpins, and high-speed stunt sections — each one built for clean lines and long, screaming slides. Learn the track, then learn how to take it sideways.

9 DRIFT CARS TO UNLOCK
Every car has its own balance, grip, and slide behavior. Find the one that matches your driving feel, then tune it for more speed, better control, and higher scores.

REALISTIC WEIGHT TRANSFER
Physics you can feel through the wheel. Load the front end, kick the rear out, and modulate throttle to keep the angle. Sloppy inputs end the drift — precise ones extend it.

PRO AI RIVALS
Race against AI drivers who hold their own line under pressure. Out-drift them, don't just out-drive them.

UPGRADES AND CUSTOMIZATION
Earn rewards from clean runs and put them into performance upgrades and visual customization.

CINEMATIC CUTSCENES
Milestone moments play out in full cinematic style as you rise through the ranks.

COMFORT-FOCUSED VR
Smooth, seated-friendly controls designed for long drift sessions on Quest. Comfort rating: [match your submission form exactly].

Compatible with Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, Quest 3S, and Quest Pro.

Hold the angle. Own the corner.
